title: Shapes all around us
examples: Teacher, what shape is a clock face?
Can you show me a square thing in the classroom?

explain.say: Look around you. Can you see any circles today?
Next, we look for squares. A square has four equal sides.
Now, let us find triangles. A triangle has three straight sides.
Finally, we see rectangles. A rectangle has four sides, but not all are equal.
Think about a door. A door is usually a rectangle shape.
A fun fact is that a circle has no corners at all.

faq.q: How many sides does a square have?
faq.a: A square has four straight sides. You can also ask: How many sides on a square? Or, what shape has four equal sides?
asks: What is the shape of a square?
How many sides does it have?

faq.q: Are all circles the same size?
faq.a: No, circles can be big or small. You can also ask: Can a circle be tiny? Or, what size can a circle be?
asks: Do all circles look the same?
Is there a size limit for a circle?

faq.q: What is the difference between a square and a rectangle?
faq.a: A square is a special rectangle where all four sides are the same length. You can also ask: Are all squares rectangles? Or, what makes a square special?
asks: Do they have to be the same size?

faq.q: Can a triangle have sides of different lengths?
faq.a: Yes, a triangle can have sides that are all different lengths. You can also ask: Must the sides be equal? Or, what if the sides are not the same?
A ball is shaped like a circle. You can also ask: Is a ball round? Or, what shape is a wheel?

facts: A circle has no straight sides or corners.
A square has four sides that are all the same length.
A triangle has exactly three straight sides.
A rectangle has four sides, with opposite sides being equal.

quiz.say: A stop sign is usually what shape?
quiz.why: Stop signs are designed to be squares, making all sides equal.

wrong.0: A circle rolls, but a stop sign needs straight edges.
wrong.1: A triangle has only three sides, which is not enough for a stop sign.
wrong.2: While it has four sides, a stop sign's sides are all the same length.

quiz.say: If you draw a picture with three straight lines connecting, what shape do you make?
quiz.why: Three straight lines always connect to form a triangle.

wrong.0: A circle is curved, not made of straight lines.
wrong.1: A rectangle needs four lines, not just three.
wrong.3: A square needs four lines to close the shape.

quiz.say: Which shape has four sides, but the top and bottom are longer than the sides?
quiz.why: This describes a rectangle where the long sides are different from the short sides.

wrong.0: A triangle only has three sides, not four.
wrong.2: In a square, all four sides must be the same length.
wrong.3: A circle does not have straight sides at all.
